notes.title: Completely Stretchy Patch V1.3 💪
notes.content:
Salutations fellow citizens of the Grombi Isles! 👋

We’ve been polishing up some Stretchy goodness for you all! Here is the latest patch for the game!

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[h3]Key Improvements[/h3]
•    Map fix for Ultrawide Monitors
•    Hoverbike lean angles tweaked for a smoother racing experience.
•    Hoverbike air control tweaks.
•    Disaster now throws Bloop into helpful hint positions. How fortunate!
•    Dialogue boxes for tutorials stay on screen better during tutorials.
•    Webbo’s legs are now easier to hold and throw.
•    Webbo’s legs no longer get stuck in draws.
•    Library shelves moved for easier view of them filling up with rescued books.
[h3]Minor fixes[/h3]
•    Town pond dredged for a more relaxing swim.
•    Alarm clock audio reduced in volume a bit.
•    Post office invested in carpet.
•    Satellite laptop now visually breaks (sorry Rodi!)
•    Blorbs Webnet Café now has several new games installed.
•    Splishi now shows you he wants to talk after you have learned to fish.
•    Lab sabotage given some extra zap.
•    Several new TV channels.
•    Several Quest markers/visuals improved in the Industrial Zone

Happy New Year and Valentines!
- Warp Digital and Super Rare Games

notes.title: Stretchy Patch V1.2.0
notes.content:
Greetings from the Grombi Isles!

Completely Stretchy has received some updates for the holidays. We hope you enjoy 🙂 

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
•    Accessibility - Option to disable Hand bob
•    Accessibility - Option to disable Body tilting on Strafing
[h3]Map Improvements[/h3]
•    Map UI improved for easier identification of your whereabouts
•    Map UI pips position fixes and animation tweaks
[h3]Quest and Bugs Fixes[/h3]
•    Achievement improvements
•    Mineshaft lift repair work to fix a softlock
•    Jimmi given Grumple Juice to make it harder for him to hide
•    Skating Scrimbli's body fixed when looking in certain directions
•    Cakeo seeds given sparkles for easier detection
•    Replaced Grumple fruit in bank heist to give Kneeo actual riches
•    Soobus dialogue fixed to reward you without needing to speak to them twice, he just wants better company.
[h3]Set Dressing[/h3]
•    Feng Shui expert sent around the isles to improve furniture positioning
•    Plugged in many TVs and Computers around the island
•    New TV shows added to the network
•    Fruit toss bunting hung due to complaint from contestants that the Isle wasn't taking their event seriously enough
•    Robin invested in a model monorail after several months saving scrudge
•    Replaced bulbs in towers lighting systems to fix flickering
•    Glow added to Elektro chamber to provide better Elektro comfort
•    Unglued several items from tables so you can pick them up
•    Sealed up some holes in the world
•    Sir Spoilalots cape found

[b]Thanks, and Happy Holidays![/b]
- Warp Digital and Super Rare Games

notes.title: CREATE YOUR OWN CITIZEN - FAN ART CONTEST
notes.content:
[h1]The Grombi Isles are in need of more citizens[/h1]
Hello stretchy enthusiasts, are your drawing hands ready?

We want YOU to create some original characters from the Grombi Isles. We want weird and wacky folks who will fit right in. All you need to do is join our discord and create a character.
[h2]Join our discord here for more information and how to enter: [url=https://discord.gg/GWCG4SSXgb]https://discord.gg/GWCG4SSXgb[/url][/h2]

[h3]Rules[/h3] [list]
[*] Submit your art via the discord
[*] You have until  11:59pm BST, Friday 20th of September to submit your character. Winners will be announced the following Monday (23rd September)
[*] Please use the character referneces to create an OC based on the available models! We sadly can't add any aliens into the game, so only current citizens can be added.
[*] Our three Favourite entries will be awarded release keys for Completely Stretchy and Uncomfortable Sticky at launch.
[*] One winner will be selected to have their character added to the game as an easter egg NPC. (if we can't pick we might choose more than one!)
[*] Submissions can be images, videos or gifs! However, you can only submit once, so make it a good one.
[*] No AI or Stolen art, only submit what you have created. [/list]

Completely Stretchy and Uncomfortably Sticky is being featured in the MIGW steam event from the 30th of September through to the 4th of October!
